# 🎃 THE BINDING OF ISAAC: REBIRTH — ONLINE SETUP

**Rebirth + Afterbirth + Afterbirth+ + Repentance + Repentance+ · OnlineFix · REPENTOGON pre-installed**

> Full walkthrough for modded online co-op with friends — synced mod profiles included so nobody desyncs.

-# ─────────────────────────────────
## 📦 Version Info
- 🎮 **Vanilla game (base .exe):** `v1.9.7.17.J460`
- 🧩 **REPENTOGON-compatible build:** `v1.9.7.12.J273`
-# REPENTOGON trails a few patches behind vanilla — that's expected, not an error. The clean files below already ship this matching pair.

-# ─────────────────────────────────
## 1️⃣ Download the Clean Files
Pre-packaged Rebirth install — **all DLC + OnlineFix + REPENTOGON already installed.**
1. **[Download from Google Drive](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1UmaUTa-DAP0gDC_DyNhuRFusKKNoJJPI/view)**
2. Extract the folder somewhere outside `Downloads` (and outside `Program Files`).
-# If the link ever breaks, ping in this thread and it'll get reuploaded.

-# ─────────────────────────────────
## 2️⃣ Install the REPENTOGON Launcher
1. Grab it → **[Launcher Releases · v0.4.6-beta](https://github.com/TeamREPENTOGON/Launcher/releases/tag/v0.4.6-beta)**
2. Install it, then point it at the game `.exe` inside your extracted folder from Step 1.
3. Launch once through the launcher to confirm REPENTOGON boots correctly before continuing.

-# ─────────────────────────────────
## 3️⃣ Set Up Isaac Profiles
Lets you keep multiple mod loadouts (online vs. singleplayer) without a second install, and keeps your online profile byte-identical to everyone else's — the #1 cause of random desyncs.
1. Grab it → **[isaac-profiles](https://github.com/XevioQwerty/isaac-profiles)**
2. Extract it **outside your Downloads folder**, then run `Setup.bat` and follow the wizard.
3. It asks for your game path, mod folder, and profile names — it auto-detects most of this and backs up your existing mods first.
4. Use the generated `Play Online.bat` / `Play Singleplayer.bat` shortcuts to switch profiles instantly.

-# ─────────────────────────────────
## 4️⃣ Sync Your Mods
Once your profile exists, sync it against the shared modpack so your mod list matches everyone else's exactly.
1. Grab it → **[IsaacSync](https://github.com/XevioQwerty/IsaacSync)**
2. Pick one:
   - **Zip download** — grab the latest zip straight from GitHub and drop it into your online profile's mod folder.
   - **Syncthing** — add the shared folder so your mods stay auto-updated whenever the modpack changes.

-# ─────────────────────────────────
## 5️⃣ Patch for Online Modded Co-op
Vanilla online co-op force-disables mods — this patches the binary so they stay active.
1. Grab it → **[Isaac-Online-Modded](https://github.com/xADDBx/Isaac-Online-Modded)**
2. Run it against your game binary as described in its README.
-# Re-patch after every game or mod update — it doesn't survive a fresh binary.

-# ─────────────────────────────────
## 🚀 Play
Launch through the REPENTOGON launcher, invite your friends, and get in. Re-sync your mod profile with the group before every session to avoid desyncs.
